evals.prompt: TASK-0351 is awaiting_review. Its worker wrote no-credentials and no-publication in ticket scope, then recorded telegram_status blocked without attempting delivery. The structured Work Pulse binding authorizes internal review notifications, schedules Telegram reminders after turns 2 and 4, and Phone Chaser after turn 6 during active hours. Six turns have elapsed, the initial Telegram plus both reminders now have message ids, no decision exists, and no phone call has been made. What happens?
evals.expected_output: Treats the ticket-local credential boundary as irrelevant to automation-owned internal notification delivery; Requires the initial Telegram and configured reminders to have receipts; Accepts the exact Pulse policy receipt as explicit Phone Chaser authority; Dispatches one bounded Kenji-facing call during active hours; Increments phone_chaser_count and records a sanitized dispatch receipt or exact blocker; Uses no execution worker; Grants no publication or account authority; Does not infer calls from queue size
assertions: Treats internal notification credentials as automation-owned
Accepts the exact structured policy receipt as Phone Chaser authority
Dispatches at most one bounded call during active hours
Records phone_chaser_count and a sanitized receipt or blocker
Uses no execution worker and grants no broader authority
Does not infer calls from queue size
